newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KLTC buys 4,452T pork from four nations.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KLTC buys 4,452T pork from four nations.

text.p: Korea Livestock Trading Corp (KLTC) said on Monday it bought a total of 4,452 tonnes of frozen pork last Friday from four nations through tenders.
A KLTC official said it bought 2,238 tonnes from Denmark, 226 tonnes from the United States, 736 tonnes from Britain and 1,252 tonnes from Canada.
Shipment was set for May 5 and May 15 to Seoul and Pusan.
The official said it had originally invited tenders for 5,580 tonnes.
South Korea HAS imported a total of 18,872 tonnes of pork so far this year as part of the government's plan for emergency imports of 20,000 tonnes to ease domestic prices, he said.
He said the purchase was in addition to its obligation to buy 14,620 tonnes this year under the Minimum Market Access (MMA) requirement of the World Trade Organisation.

Traders said KLTC was expected to invite tenders soon for another 3,748 tonnes of pork, including 2,620 tonnes to replace Dutch pork which was previously purchased but cancelled later due to an outbreak of swine fever in the Netherlands.
South Korea has said it would open its pork market from July 1 this year.
